required_audit_coverage.name: required_audit_coverage
required_audit_coverage.detail: report covers all 48 Required Audit items with substantive aligned answers
required_audit_items: Is `decision_meta` valid JSON with `schema_version=1`?
Is status `APPROVED` and mainline `project_governance`?
Is `reverse-agent-iteration@v2` active in `.codex-skills/registry.json`?
Is `decision_packet.md` treated as the sole current task authority and `task_packet.json` as background only?
Is the previous independent audit outcome recorded as `REWORK_REQUIRED`?
Was the stale previous-round command-plan rejected and regenerated for this decision and round?
Does the regenerated command-plan carry the current decision ID and round ID?
Does the regenerated command-plan explicitly authorize every executed command and preserve omitted-command restrictions?
Were any unauthorized or omitted commands executed?
Is the round limited to closeout chronology and provenance repair?
Were the existing closeout, report-summary, execution-log, final-check, archive, state-manifest, and post-final-sync mechanisms reused rather than duplicated?
Does `pytest_result.txt` preserve the observed command order?
Does `execution_log.json` preserve the observed transcript chronology without reordering?
Do `pytest_result.txt` and `execution_log.json` agree on the final lifecycle-mutating command?
Does `final_gate_result.json` derive its command-order conclusion from the observed transcript?
Does final-check fail when the transcript proves a command occurred after the claimed final close-round?
Is stable run-closeout evidence generated before report finalization?
Does report finalization identify the live `run_closeout_result.json` path?
Does report finalization contain the full live run-closeout SHA-256?
Does report finalization match the live run-closeout `generated_at` and status?
Does report finalization record an observed `report_finalized_at`?
Is `report_finalized_at` later than or equal to the referenced stable closeout evidence time?
Does the final archive refresh occur after report finalization?
Does the final round manifest or equivalent closeout artifact record `archive_refreshed_at`?
Is `archive_refreshed_at >= report_finalized_at` proven by current artifact fields?
Does the final archive provenance record its basis and status?
Does the archived report digest match the final live report digest at archive time?
Do archived and live `codex_execution_report.md` match?
Do archived and live `execution_report.md` match?
Do archived and live `pytest_result.txt` match?
Does the round manifest match the final decision, report, pytest, and closeout state?
Do both report aliases carry semantically identical summary and report-finalization fields?
Does `report_summary_synthesis.json` match both final report aliases?
Does final-check include and pass chronology, report-finalization, archive-refresh, and archived/live parity checks?
Does final-check preserve `state_manifest_freshness=PASS`?
Does `current_context_packet.json` match the current decision and round after post-final sync?
Does post-final evidence sync prove that context was generated after the final gate state it references?
Does the final Required Audit body avoid placeholders, generic claims, contradictions, and future-tense completion claims?
Do Required Audit answers cite current artifact paths and observed fields rather than only function names or design steps?
Were all forbidden paths left untouched?
Were only explicitly allowed source, test, and project-state files modified?
Were no Runner, Web, workflow, model API, database, cleanup, reverse-tool, or sample-solving capabilities used?
Was publication withheld until required validation passed?
If publication occurred, was one short-lived branch reused for all commits and review fixes?
If publication occurred, were only explicit in-scope paths staged?
If publication occurred, did the current command-plan explicitly authorize branch/commit/push/PR commands?
If publication occurred, was direct push to `main`, force push, merge, rebase, tag mutation, workflow mutation, and secret mutation avoided?
If publication could not occur because credentials or command authority were absent, did the report state that limitation without claiming success?
